verdict.rationale: Mistral Document AI's documented bbox_annotation feature annotates the bounding boxes the OCR model extracts for charts and figures, including user-requested descriptions or captions and chart-to-table conversion. Each page also returns a blocks array with bounding boxes and structural labels. A hands-on tester saw extracted image references returned with coordinates, and another user confirmed embedded images can be extracted, which supports image crops traceable to their position. Missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation of the image-crop output format and coordinate schema, and independent evaluation of figure-caption/VLM summary quality.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, figures and charts are extracted or described (VLM summaries, image crops) with positions traceable back to the source page

citations.quote: bbox_annotation: gives you the annotation of the bboxes extracted by the OCR model (charts/ figures etc) based on user requirement and provided bbox/image annotation format. The user may ask to describe/caption the figure for instance.
Conversion of charts to tables, extraction of fine print from figures, or definition of custom image types
When enabled, each page contains a `blocks` array with paragraph-level bounding boxes, structural block labels, and extracted content in reading order.
It returned `![img-0.jpeg](img-0.jpeg)` with coordinates for a single image covering the whole page
can extract embedded images from the text
